b64_strb.effect: For tracked RAM, invalidate_store removes the aligned 32-bit shadow word at 0x030000C0. This cannot alias the saved LR slot at 0x03007E10. On the failing route the shadow was already empty from B58.

limitations: All register, I/O, and memory values above are abstract compiler states, not observed guest CPU values.

The 0x080003B8 clear is the first clear_io callback in this static worklist run; it is bounded to this run and does not establish ROM runtime behavior.
